title: Billing changes an agent asks for
items: An API key or agent can ask for a billing change (the plan or its interval, a team's seats, add-on blocks and overage, cancelling or keeping a plan) instead of being refused: the route answers with an approval that shows the quote, what changes, when, and what is charged now
Approving makes exactly the quoted change, and only while a fresh quote still matches; if the price or the subscription moved, nothing is changed and the asker is told to ask again
Changes paid at a checkout (more monthly blocks, one-time blocks, overage the first time) take the owner to Polar's checkout when they approve
A team's change can only be asked for by a key or agent of the team's owner
